app.welcomeBody: Type a path in the bar above (Windows or {{wslPath}}), or from any terminal run
app.welcomeShortcuts: Ctrl+, Settings · F5 refresh · Ctrl+W close tab
app.welcomePalette: Ctrl+P find a file · Ctrl+Shift+P commands

settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: Settings come from a newer version; changes apply now but won't be saved.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Git's own messages (errors, the details of a fetch or push) keep the language of your git installation.

background.title: Background image
background.hint: The image is copied into Debutuuru's data folder. Panels turn translucent so it shows through.

ssh.title: Git & SSH
ssh.useWslKeys: Use WSL's SSH keys for Windows repositories
ssh.useWslKeysHint: Push/pull of Windows repos runs wsl.exe -e ssh, so the keys, ssh-agent and ~/.ssh/config from your distro work here too. Off: your normal Git for Windows setup (keys in %USERPROFILE%\.ssh, Credential Manager for HTTPS).
ssh.wslReposHint: Repositories inside WSL always use that distro's own ssh. Passwordless keys and ssh-agent need no setup; when a passphrase or password is needed, Debutuuru asks in a dialog and never stores it.

wslCommand.title: WSL command
wslCommand.hint: Lets you run debutuuru . from a WSL terminal to open that folder here. It adds ~/.local/bin/debutuuru, a small script that only calls this app.
wslCommand.foreign: {{path}} already exists and wasn't written by Debutuuru, so it's left as is.
wslCommand.ready: Ready. Open a new terminal and run debutuuru .
wslCommand.shadowed: Installed, but debutuuru runs {{path}} first in your PATH.
wslCommand.notOnPath: Installed, but ~/.local/bin isn't in your PATH.
wslCommand.addToPathHint: “Add to PATH” appends one line to {{file}}.

updates.title: Updates
updates.restartNote: The app closes and opens again when it's installed.
updates.checkOnStart: Check for updates when the app starts
updates.checkOnStartHint: Only checks and shows a button in the status bar; nothing is installed until you click it. Updates are signed and verified before installing.

style.title: Style
style.rgbHint: The bars cycle their colors (Gamer) or a light sweeps across them (Circuit). Off when the system asks to reduce animations.
style.hint: Gamer adds neon glow, sharper corners and RGB bars; Circuit an electric blue-to-green gradient, carbon texture, circuit traces and a bold italic title font. Both work with any theme; Neon, Cyberpunk, Crimson, Toxic and Circuit are made for them.

git.historyHint: Double-click a commit to browse its files

graph.label: Commit history
graph.author: Author
graph.empty: No commits yet. Stage files and make the first commit.

diff.noTextChanges: No textual changes (binary file or mode change)
diff.truncated: Large file: only the first 2 MB of each version are compared.
diff.onlyLineEndings: Only the line endings changed (CRLF / LF)
diff.contextTitle: Unchanged lines shown around each change
diff.wordsTitle: Highlight the words that changed inside a line
diff.whitespaceTitle: Hide changes that only add, remove or move whitespace

filesView.revision: Which version of the files to show
filesView.label: Files
filesView.selectFile: Select a file to see its content
filesView.truncated: Large file: showing the first {{shown}} of {{size}}.
filesView.linkNotFound: “{{spec}}” isn't a file of this repository (an external package, or a path it can't resolve).

remote.pullTitle: Pull from {{upstream}} (your git config decides merge/rebase)
remote.noUpstream: No upstream: push the branch first
remote.forceTitle: Overwrites the remote branch, but refuses if someone else pushed since your last fetch

outcome.no_upstream: This branch has no upstream to pull from. Push it first, or set one with `git branch -u`.
outcome.no_remote: This repository has no remote. Add one with `git remote add origin <url>`.
outcome.several_remotes: Several remotes and no upstream: choose one with `git push -u <remote> HEAD`.
outcome.host_key_declined: Connection stopped: the server's host key was not trusted

advice.sshAuthWindows: SSH from Windows couldn't authenticate. If your SSH keys live in WSL, turn on “Use WSL's SSH keys for Windows repositories” in Settings (Ctrl+,).
advice.sshAuth: SSH couldn't authenticate. Check with `ssh -T git@<host>` in a terminal that your key is accepted and the repository URL is right.
advice.hostKey: The server's host key wasn't trusted, so nothing was sent. Run Fetch again and accept it if the fingerprint matches your Git host's published one.
advice.httpsAuth: Credentials were rejected. Most hosts need a personal access token instead of a password, or Git Credential Manager.
advice.rejected: The remote has commits you don't have. Pull first, then push.
advice.diverged: Your branch and the remote have diverged. Use Pull ▸ Rebase or Pull ▸ Merge.
advice.localChanges: Commit or stash your local changes before pulling.
advice.conflict: The pull stopped with conflicts. Resolve them, then commit.
advice.network: Couldn't reach the remote. Check your connection, VPN or proxy.

prompt.fingerprintHint: Only accept if this fingerprint matches what your Git host publishes.
prompt.notStored: Sent only to this git process. Debutuuru never stores it.

commitPanel.merge: Merge: changes against the first parent ({{parent}})

palette.noRepo: Open a repository to search its files
palette.hintFiles: ↑↓ move · Enter open · > commands · Esc close
